nets.note: The board's only remaining free pin. It is ADC2_CH6, which is useless as an analog input with Wi-Fi on, but perfectly good as a digital output.
Diode-OR'd with the USER button. GPIO21 is the only RTC-capable pin left on this board, and a deep-sleep wake source has to be RTC-capable.

buses.pullup_source: 10k on each module; no discrete resistors fitted

required_pins.reason: The six audio pins map onto the six free pins exactly, with nothing to spare. Any further peripheral has to go behind the expander or replace something.

accepted_findings.JTAG_COST: GPIO40/41/42 carry the I2S microphone because there is nowhere else for them to go: the board has exactly six free pins and audio needs six. The cost is hardware JTAG debugging, which this project has never used - USB-Serial-JTAG on GPIO19/20 is unaffected and covers flashing and the console. Accepted knowingly, not overlooked.
